A2.decision: Thermal interface lifecycle first conditionally; internal converter margin second; optical post-stress serious follow-up finalist. Fan/HBM/CMP have stronger directly described return edges than the exact thermal synthesis.

A2.status: disposed_for_this_revision; empirical gaps and cross-review comparison remain

B2.reason: Thermal post-cycle margin is conditional lead; optical stronger observed post-stress return, internal converter sharper source-specific electrical mechanism. C2.reason: Thermal remains conditional first, now interface durability; internal converter is the narrow power alternative. Promote any alternative with a real unresolved case and owned variables.

items.coordinator_decision: Conditional thermal-interface durability lead accepted as a pilot-selection judgment. items.remaining_dissent_or_unknown: Alternative priority can reverse with owner cases/access; no material factual dissent.

items.question: Require a verified engineering change: initial TIM resistance versus aging; SPI volume versus completed joint; simulated channel versus built sample; fan printed versus molded; fixture artifact versus DUT defect; controller trace versus source/load fidelity. What validates causal and product transfer claims?

A2.decision: Require causal interventions, measurement controls and independent product-representative verification for every candidate.
A2.reason: Thermal initial-to-aged and TTV-to-product; SPI-to-joint; printed-to-molded fan; measured channel-to-COM-to-actual receiver; optical prebond/time-zero-to-poststress; converter commanded-to-real source/load waveform must not be conflated. Preserve interfaces before destructive remount/failure analysis.
A2.status: disposed_for_this_revision; empirical gaps and cross-review comparison remain

B2.reason: Initial resistance must survive cycling; SPI deposit must produce reliable joints; simulated channels need built samples; printed fans need production construction; fixture effects need independent calibration; load command needs measured waveform fidelity. C2.reason: Treat thermal initial/aged and TTV/product separately; require downstream joint evidence after SPI, molded confirmation after printed fan, built/device validation after simulation/COM, fixture artifact controls, and actual source/load fidelity. No proxy-only solution release.

items.coordinator_decision: Require cause-discriminating controls and final product outcomes, not proxy-only acceptance. Preserve aged interfaces before remounting, use sister specimens for destructive inspection and verify independent builds and withheld conditions.
